explanation._note: Documentation only; ignored by build_multiple_linear_models.py. Paths are relative to the project root unless absolute.
explanation.partition_path: Path to partition_output.npz produced by build_partition.py. Provides the invariant embedding and merge graph used to classify states into components.
explanation.data_path: Path to the .npz used for fitting EDMD models. Must contain X and Y; an optional trajectories array enables phase plots.
explanation.validation_data_path: Labeled .npz for classification-gated RMSE evaluation (must contain labels). Defaults to data_path when omitted.
explanation.centers_global_data_path: Path to the .npz from generate_data.py that contains centers_global. Used to build the EDMD dictionary (independent of data_path).
explanation.output_path: Where to write regional_models.npz: per-component EDMD operators K_l, reconstruction maps R_l, and the EDMD dictionary parameters.
explanation.target_equilibria: One inline state vector per class for anchor-based classification. Mutually exclusive with target_data_paths.
explanation.target_data_paths: List of .npz paths, one per class, for anchor-based classification. Mutually exclusive with target_equilibria.
explanation.system_name: Name passed to plotting routines for titles/bounds.
explanation.edmd_gamma: Bandwidth for the Gaussian RBFs in the EDMD dictionary (independent of the partition dictionary).
explanation.edmd_d_poly: Polynomial degree in the EDMD dictionary; -1 means RBF-only.
explanation.number_centers_edmd: Number of RBF centers in the EDMD dictionary, randomly subsampled from centers_global in centers_global_data_path. Use -1 to use the full pool, 0 for a polynomial-only dictionary (edmd_gamma is then ignored; edmd_d_poly must be >= 0).
explanation.compare_vanilla_edmd: If true, also fit one global (vanilla) EDMD model on ALL snapshot pairs in data_path (no partition-dropped samples excluded, unlike the regional models) and report the same one-step and rollout metrics side by side with the regional models, overlay it in phase_trajectories.png, and write rollout_errors.png.
explanation.vanilla_edmd_gamma: Optional override of the RBF bandwidth for the vanilla EDMD dictionary. Leave all three vanilla_* dictionary keys null so vanilla EDMD uses exactly the same dictionary (same centers) as the regional models.
explanation.vanilla_edmd_d_poly: Optional override of the polynomial degree for the vanilla EDMD dictionary; -1 means RBF-only. null reuses edmd_d_poly.
explanation.vanilla_number_centers_edmd: Optional override of the number of RBF centers for the vanilla EDMD dictionary (-1 = full pool, 0 = polynomial-only). null reuses number_centers_edmd.
explanation.vanilla_output_path: Where to write vanilla_edmd_model.npz (global K, R and dictionary parameters). Defaults to output_path's directory.
explanation.min_samples_per_cell: Minimum number of snapshot pairs a component needs before an EDMD model is fitted for it.
explanation.prediction_horizon: Number of one-step predictions T used in rollout diagnostics.
explanation.n_rollout_trajectories: Number of trajectories rolled out for gated rollout-error diagnostics.
explanation.num_phase_plot: Number of randomly sampled initial conditions for phase plots when ICs_phase_plot is empty. Set to 0 to disable random sampling.
explanation.ICs_phase_plot: Optional list of initial state vectors for phase plots, e.g. [[x1, x2], [x1, x2]]. When non-empty, num_phase_plot is ignored and true trajectories are simulated from these ICs.
explanation.run_gated_evaluation: If false, stop after the ICs_phase_plot rollouts (their errors are still printed and plotted) and skip the classification-gated evaluation on validation_data_path. Use while tuning the dictionary parameters; set true for the final numbers.
explanation.random_state: Seed for randomly subsampling EDMD centers from centers_global, selecting rollout trajectories, phase-plot ICs, and other stochastic steps.
explanation.show_plots: If true, display plots interactively in addition to saving them.
explanation.plots_output_dir: Directory where build plots are saved: partition_scatter.png and phase_trajectories.png.
explanation.plot_data_output_path: Path to the .npz archive of plot arrays (partition scatter and phase trajectories) used by generate_plots.py.
explanation.paper_figures_relpath: Relative path under figures/paper/ where generate_plots.py writes paper figures, e.g. duffing/multiple_linear_models.
